purpose: Acquire versioned BRP 2025 silage-maize geometry and a versioned BRO SGM soil map for a reproducible maize-by-CCNL6 spatial crosswalk.

inputs.version_requirement: Persist exact downloaded model/version metadata and SHA-256 before transformation.

mapping_contract.historical_boundary: BRO SGM is a current/versioned spatial model; it is not identical to the historical LSK profile-domain basis used for the 2018 CC-NL area estimates.

output_contract.admission_rule: No crosswalk is admitted unless mapping coverage is complete, geometry closure is within declared tolerance, provenance hashes are persisted, and the BRO-to-CCNL6 mapping has been independently reviewed.

current_blockers: Raw BRP/BRO files are not materialized in the repository.
BRO soil_unit_code to CCNL6 mapping has zero qualified rows and requires soil-expert review.
A current crop-soil crosswalk remains a spatial approximation to the six CC-NL reporting domains, not a reconstruction of historical LSK domain membership.
